author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Currently `ECLCCCompute1` hooks topo clusters with `atomicCas`, while `representative()` and `ECLCCFlatten` read and write pfrh_topoId with plain accesses.

On an MI300X the plain loads can see stale values, `ECLCCFlatten` leaves some rechits pointing to a non-root `topoId`, and the later PF clustering kernels read invalid indices and trap.

Use atomic loads and stores for these accesses, as the original ECL-CC code uses volatile ones.

Fixes a reproducible crash when running the Run 3 HLT on MI300X GPUs, with no impact on the HLT performance.

#### PR validation:

No crashes are observed with the fix over 25 tests:

metric | before | after 
---|---|---
stability | 4 crashes in 30 jobs | 0 crashes in 25 jobs
performance | 97.4  0.3 ev/s | 97.6  0.2 ev/s
title: Use atomic accesses to `pfrh_topoId` in ECL-CC
